title: Derivative of the polar map y ↦ (|y|, arctan(⟨y,e⟩/⟨y,a⟩)) at a point x with ⟨x,a⟩ ≠ 0
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ and a, e, x ∈ ℝ^P with ⟨x,a⟩ ≠ 0 (no orthonormality of a, e is assumed). Put F̃(y) := (|y|, arctan(⟨y,e⟩/⟨y,a⟩)) ∈ ℝ × ℝ. Then for every v ∈ ℝ^P the Fréchet derivative of F̃ at x (fderiv ℝ F̃ x) satisfies DF̃(x)v = (⟨x,v⟩/|x|, ⟨⟨x,a⟩e − ⟨x,e⟩a, v⟩/(⟨x,a⟩² + ⟨x,e⟩²)).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (a e x : Euclid P), inner ℝ x a ≠ 0 → ∀ v : Euclid P, fderiv ℝ (fun y : Euclid P => (‖y‖, Real.arctan (inner ℝ y e / inner ℝ y a))) x v = (inner ℝ x v / ‖x‖, inner ℝ (inner ℝ x a • e - inner ℝ x e • a) v / (inner ℝ x a ^ 2 + inner ℝ x e ^ 2))
